_comment: Edit this file to change the rank popups. 'books' is the number of different books scanned that earns the rank. The title and message are keys in Localizable.xcstrings, which holds the Japanese; add a translation there if you change the English. Rebuild the app after editing.

ranks.title: Beginner
ranks.message: You've scanned your first book. Every library starts with one.

ranks.title: Novice Collector
ranks.message: Five books in. Something is starting to grow.

ranks.title: Budding Library
ranks.message: Ten books. You have the start of a real library.

ranks.title: The Kon-Mari Recommendation
ranks.message: Thirty books. Does each one spark joy?

ranks.title: Good for the kids
ranks.message: A home with 80 or more books helps children's literacy.

ranks.title: Da Vinci's Library
ranks.message: 116 books: about what Leonardo da Vinci owned. Good company!

ranks.title: The Estonian Average
ranks.message: This is how many books are owned by the average Estonian (according to the Guardian).

ranks.title: Tsundoku Pro
ranks.message: 300 books. You've mastered the art of owning more books than you've read.

ranks.title: Tiny Bookstore
ranks.message: 500 books. You could open a tiny shop with this.

ranks.title: Little Bookstore on the Corner
ranks.message: 1,000 books! The neighborhood is lucky to have you.
